title: Microscopic Parametric Correlations and Spectral Rigidity in the Non-Hermitian Threefold Way
summary: We study microscopic spectral correlations between two nearby parameter values in the three non-Hermitian Gaussian bulk classes: $A$ (unconstrained), $AI^\dagger$ (complex symmetric), and $AII^\dagger$ (complex self-dual, with each degenerate doublet counted once). Parameter dependence is modelled by stationary matrix Ornstein--Uhlenbeck evolution, whose microscopic time scale is $N^{-1}$.
